title: Ulterlands: Worlds Apart
description: Go beyond dimensions; explore a realm unknown yet familiar.
body:
![TitleLogo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bca00ba29649c8911375d9bf41543c38c123e5e0.png)

Welcome to a world beyond our own with creatures and biomes that may seem familiar. Using powerful magic and overworld science, creating a portal capable of traversing the multiverse is possible...

**THIS IS AN EXTREMELY BRIEF OVERVIEW. PLEASE VISIT THE [OFFICIAL WIKI](https://sites.google.com/view/ulterlands/home)**

## **HOW TO ENTER** ## 
### OBSIDIAN B12 ###
_A chemical compound created using Obsidian and other crystalline materials._

### RIFT TOTEM ###
_A magical totem created in the image of a space-faring species. Can be used to ignite an Obsidian B12 frame to create a World Gate._


## **BIOMES** ##

### PLACID WOODS ###
_A tranquil forest with tall colourful trees, shrubs, vibrant flowers and geode-boulders with magnificent crystals._

### SANGUINE GLADE ###
_A conundrum of a forest: covered in damp moss, shrubs and pale fungus yet dotted with dry stone spikes and cooling magma._

### VOCAL SANDS ###
_A barren landscape sparsely decorated by violet stalks, crystals, thorns and toxic growths. Suspended above the ground with odd magic, pieces of the land float in the air._

### DEEP HORIZON ###
_A mysterious zone where the physical and spiritual planes converge; archaic skeletons, marine flora, and ancient ruins dot the starry dunes._


## **EXTRAS** ##
_All of the above, 14 new mobs, a new crafting system, an entire magic system (with 7 spells and 11 magic items), a new armour tier, 6 new status effects, redstone components, building block sets, and much more await you._

I recommend using JEI for easy access to basic recipes.
